def regexr_transform(column):

    pattern = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z]+')
    for i, value in enumerate(column):
        column[i] = pattern.sub(lambda x: x.group(0).upper(), value).replace('  ', ' ')

    pattern = re.compile(r'([Gg]overnment|[Vv]oluntary) ([Nn]on-[Pp]rofit|[Pp]rivate)')
    for i, value in enumerate(column):
        column[i] = pattern.sub(lambda x: x.group(1).lower() + '-' + x.group(2).lower(), value)

    return column


This expression standardizes the capitalization and removes extra spaces for each value in the HospitalOwner column. It also ensures consistent hyphen usage for hospital ownership types (Government, Voluntary, Non-Profit, Private). The resulting data will be more concise and easier to analyze for changes among counties for the same type of hospital ownership.
